summary: Stereo waveshaping distortion: a tilt EQ before a choice of curves (soft tanh, hard clip, asymmetric tube, sine wavefolder, 4-bit crush), drive and DC bias into it, tape-like release smear and signal-following dust after it, then output gain and a dry/wet mix. No oversampling, so high notes driven hard alias.
use_for: Waveshaping distortion with several curves and a tilt EQ before the shaper.
quirks: The profiler typed it a utility (it measures flat at the defaults, where Drive is 0 dB); it is a waveshaping distortion.
Its own value texts are bare numbers: the manifest gives Drive and Output in dB from the code ((value - 48) x 0.5 dB).
No oversampling: high notes driven hard alias, most with Hard, Fold and Crush.
Output at its maximum (+24 dB) is hot (+14.6 dBFS peak in the profile).

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Input drive into shaper (48 = 0 dB, range ±24 dB)
parameters.how: Sets how hard the signal drives the shaper, from -24 to +24 dB in 0.5 dB steps.
parameters.sound: More drive adds more distortion; at 0 dB a quiet signal is barely changed.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.how: Chooses the curve: soft, hard clip, tube, wavefolder or crush.
parameters.sound: Soft warms, hard buzzes, tube adds even harmonics, fold rings metallically and crush sounds lo-fi.

parameters.name: Tone
parameters.description: Pre-shaper tilt EQ (64 = flat). Tilt around 1 kHz: −100 % weights the lows ×1.75 and the highs ×0.25, +98 % the other way, 0 % flat
parameters.how: Tilts the spectrum before the shaper around 1 kHz, from -100 percent (darker) to +98 percent (brighter).
parameters.sound: A darker tilt makes the distortion rounder; a brighter one makes it bite.

parameters.name: Bias
parameters.description: Pre-shaper DC bias (64 = none, ±64 = ±1.0). A DC offset into the shaper, in % of full scale (the DC blocker removes it after)
parameters.how: Adds a DC offset before the shaper, from -100 to +98 percent of full scale.
parameters.sound: Makes the clipping lopsided, which adds even harmonics and a thicker, tube-like colour.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet mix (0 = full dry, 127 = full wet)
parameters.how: Blends dry and shaped signal from 0 to 100 percent.
parameters.sound: Low mixes keep the original and add grit; full wet is all distortion.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Output makeup gain (48 = 0 dB, range ±24 dB)
parameters.how: Sets the level after the shaper, from -24 to +24 dB.
parameters.sound: Pulls the louder, driven signal back to the level it started at.

parameters.name: Hysteresis
parameters.description: Tape-like asymmetric release smear (0 = off). The release smear's time constant (the rise's is a tenth of it); 0 is off
parameters.how: Smears the release after the shaper with a time constant up to 10 ms; 0 is off.
parameters.sound: Tails round off and bass gets fatter, like magnetic tape.

parameters.name: Dust
parameters.how: Mixes noise that follows the signal's level into the shaper, from 0 to 100 percent; 0 is off.
parameters.sound: Adds a layer of hiss that comes and goes with the music and is distorted with it.
